description: Sums jfb_production_stats.volume (CY) for a project across an inclusive report_date range, optionally scoped to one equipment unit. Backs the 'Total Volume Removed' auto metric on the cover-page Metrics tab. Auto metrics are never persisted (see METRICS_MIGRATION_PLAN.md §1) -- app code calls this once per Day/Week/Total column with a different date range rather than storing a result.
direct_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ps.volume), 0) AS total_volume FROM usdf.jfb_production_stats ps JOIN usdf.jfb_reports r ON r.id = ps.report_id WHERE r.project_id = p_project_id AND r.report_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND (p_equipment_id IS NULL OR ps.equipment_id = p_equipment_id)

parameters.name: p_project_id
parameters.description: Project to scope the sum to.

parameters.name: p_start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the report_date range -- today's date for Day, the week's start for Week, the project's start date (or a very early date) for Total.

parameters.name: p_end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the report_date range -- typically the report date being viewed.

parameters.name: p_equipment_id
parameters.description: Optional equipment filter, matching the old app's equipment_filter column. Null (the default) includes all equipment.

columns.name: total_volume
columns.description: Summed volume (CY) across matched production_stats rows; 0 when none match.
